Anforderungen:
• Degree in automation, electrical engineering, software engineering, IT or a comparable technical field

• Several years of experience in automation, PLC software development, machine control or a related engineering discipline

• Experience in leading or coordinating technical teams in development or engineering projects

• Structured and solution-oriented working style with strong communication skills in German and English and the ability to motivate and develop people

Dann sind Sie in unserem Speditionsteam im Bereich Manufacturing and Logistics genau richtig. In dieser vielseitigen Rolle stellen Sie die reibungslose administrative Abwicklung internationaler Transporte von Maschinen und Ersatzteilen sicher und tragen aktiv zu einer effizienten, termingerechten und kundenorientierten Lieferkette bei.

Aufgaben:
• Sie wickeln Export- und Crosstrade-Sendungen für Maschinen und Ersatzteile selbstständig und kundenorientiert ab

• Sie betreuen definierte Ländergebiete, übernehmen Spezialaufgaben im Speditionsteam und kommunizieren proaktiv mit internen Schnittstellen, internationalen Standorten, Behörden und Transportdienstleistern

• Sie erstellen exportkonforme Versand- und Transportdokumente und stellen gemeinsam mit internen und externen Partnern eine korrekte Importabwicklung im Empfangsland sicher

• Sie erteilen Versandinstruktionen an Spediteure und Logistikpartner, überwachen Versandtermine und koordinieren multimodale Transporte

• Sie holen Transportofferten ein, vergleichen und bewerten diese nach definierten Auswahlkriterien und stellen die Einhaltung aller zoll- und exportrelevanten Vorgaben sicher

Anforderungen:
• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise ergänzt durch Weiterbildung oder Berufserfahrung in Spedition, Export oder internationaler Logistik

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Exportabwicklung bzw. internationalen Transportadministration sowie gute Kenntnisse in Versanddokumentation, internationalen Transporten und administrativen Logistikprozessen

• Kenntnisse in Zolltarifierung, Zollabwicklung oder Exportkontrolle von Vorteil

• Strukturierte, selbstständige und proaktive Persönlichkeit mit hoher Kunden- und Serviceorientierung, Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit

• Flexibilität und Anpassungsfähigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld sowie gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, idealerweise SAP-Erfahrung, und sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Wir bieten:
Attraktiver Ferienanspruch
Ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis zu 30 Tage Ferien pro Jahr abhängig vom Lebensjahr.

Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept
Wir bieten ein OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax für 365 CHF + 400CHF ÖV-Guthaben sowie ein attraktives Erstklass-Abonnement oder kostenlose Parkplätze.

Personalrestaurant VIVA
Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9, 00 CHF.

Arbeitgeberfinanzierter Pensionsplan
Die Bühler Pensionskasse bietet ihren Mitarbeitenden eine eigenständige Pensionskasse, die eine verlässliche finanzielle Abischerung im Ruhestand sicherstellt: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sportangebote
Wir fördern die sportliche Betätigung durch eigenorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie durch Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness.

Health-Port
Wir setzen uns für Gesundheitsprävention durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse sowie einen Betriebsarzt ein.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Avez-vous un point faible pour le traitement administratif des transactions d'exportation et souhaitez-vous assumer la responsabilité dans un environnement dynamique? Ensuite, vous êtes exactement dans notre équipe d'expédition dans le domaine de la fabrication et de la logistique. Dans ce rôle polyvalent, vous veillez à la gestion administrative des transports internationaux de machines et de pièces de rechange et contribuez activement à une chaîne d'approvisionnement efficace, opportune et orientée vers le client. Tâches :
• Vous manipulez des expéditions d'exportation et de commerce pour des machines et des pièces détachées indépendamment et orientées vers le client
• Ils gèrent des territoires de pays définis, assument des tâches spéciales au sein de l'équipe d'envoi et communiquent de manière proactive avec les interfaces internes, les sites internationaux, les autorités et les fournisseurs de services de transport.
• Vous créez des documents d'expédition et de transport conformes à l'exportation et, avec des partenaires internes et externes, vous assurez le traitement correct des importations dans le pays destinataire
• Vous fournissez des instructions d'expédition aux transporteurs et aux partenaires logistiques, surveillez les dates d'expédition et coordonnez les transports multimodal
• Ils obtiennent des offres de transport, les comparent et les évaluent selon des critères de sélection définis et veillent au respect de toutes les exigences en matière de douane et d'exportation. Exigences
• Formation commerciale terminée, idéalement complétée par une formation complémentaire ou une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine de la logistique d'expédition, d'exportation ou internationale
• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans le traitement des exportations et l'administration des transports internationaux ainsi que de bonnes connaissances dans la documentation maritime, les transports internationaux et les processus logistiques administratifs
• Connaissance des tarifs douaniers, du dédouanement ou du contrôle des exportations
• Personnalité structurée, indépendante et proactive, forte orientation client et service, force de communication et travail d'équipe
• Flexibilité et adaptabilité dans un environnement dynamique ainsi que de bonnes compétences MS Office, idéalement expérience SAP, et de très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais en rédaction et en écriture Nous offrons: Droit aux congés annuels attractifs Temps suffisant pour les loisirs et les intérêts personnels - nous offrons de 25 à 30 jours de vacances par an selon l'année de la vie. Concept de mobilité attractive Nous offrons un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + demi-taxe pour 365 CHF + 400CHF crédit de transport en commun ainsi qu'un abonnement de première classe attrayant ou un parking gratuit. Restaurant du personnel VIVA Nous offrons à nos employés un menu de fitness quotidien à partir de 9.00 CHF. Régime de retraite financé par l'employeur Bühler Pensionskasse offre à ses salariés une caisse de retraite indépendante qui assure une retraite financière fiable: www.pk-buhler.ch Activités sportives Nous promouvons le sport par l'entraînement en circuit auto-organisé et des groupes de course ainsi que des bons de mise à jour et de fitness actif. Port sanitaire Nous sommes engagés dans la prévention de la santé par des analyses de laboratoire, des massages, des conseils nutritionnels, la physiothérapie, des cours de groupe et un médecin d'entreprise. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits dans les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité. Nous voulons innover pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Senior Installation Supervisor at Bühler you are managing and leading a team of technician required for the installation of big and / or complex projects (X-BU, type A projects). You would be responsible for the planning, preparation and execution of the installation supervision, within scope of work associated to the assigned project. Would you like to take on this new challenge? We look forward to receiving your application!

Aufgaben:
• You get sure that the personnel assigned is fully acquainted with the site specific rules, safety regulations and environmental protection measures and that they perform their work accordingly as well as you perform installation according to the specifications and engineering documents, taking into account the safety instructions, environmental protection measures and local regulations

• You monitor progress of construction against the program, and take steps to ensure the program is achieved. You initiate as required mitigation/ preventive actions to achieve target program timely with the support of the Site Manager or Project Manager

• You conduct or attend daily and weekly meetings with Bühler staff and subcontractors, ensure that the Site Manager and the Project Manager receive regular information updates as well as correct behaviour and good teamwork within the installation and commissioning team in accordance with company policy and local requirements/ regulations

• You ensure proper reporting while identify, document and communicate any deviations from customer contract as well as you are responsible for maintaining an intensive customer relationship and a high level of customer satisfaction

Anforderungen:
• Engineering degree as well as 10 years of experience as Chief Installation Supervisor or proof of sufficient skills

• Technical and commercial knowledge covering multiple disciplines

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, including the ability to interface effectively with people inside and outside of the company

• Strong planning, organising and priority setting skills, with a proven ability to manage teams

• Strong customer focus, sound judgment and decision making and problem solving skills

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Bühler come Intern in Market Development – Grains & Food e contribuisci a un compito strategico incentrato sulla definizione di future opportunità di crescita. In questo ruolo, esplorerai paesaggi di mercato emergenti, analizzerai catene di valore e dinamiche di mercato, e identificherai opportunità di business ad alto potenziale all'incrocio tra sistemi alimentari, innovazione e tecnologia. Il ruolo è posizionato all'interno dell'Ufficio CEO di Grains & Food a livello divisionale e riporta direttamente alla Responsabile Strategia. Offre un'esposizione eccezionale ai decisori senior, con una stretta collaborazione tra la leadership di Business Area e la gestione a livello C. Questo tirocinio di 12 mesi offre un'opportunità unica per lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente esplorativo e dare un contributo significativo alla direzione futura dell'azienda.

Aufgaben:
• Esplorare e strutturare nuove aree di crescita analizzando catene di valore, dinamiche di mercato e driver chiave del settore.

• Identificare applicazioni ad alto potenziale e opportunità di business combinando intuizioni di mercato con prospettive tecnologiche.

• I punti di forza e le capacità interne di Bühler nelle aree aziendali per scoprire sinergie, lacune e punti di leva.

• Sviluppa raccomandazioni strategiche basate sui fatti e approfondimenti pronti a decidere per sostenere le future decisioni aziendali.

• Priorizzare gli spazi opportunità basati sull'attrattiva del mercato, sulla vestibilità strategica e sul potenziale valore di Bühler.

Anforderungen:
• Sei uno studente di Master o recentemente laureato in Business e Strategia, Business Innovation, International Management, o un campo correlato.

• Porti una vera curiosità per l'innovazione, i sistemi alimentari e le tecnologie future.

• Pensi in modo strutturato e puoi tradurre argomenti complessi in chiare intuizioni.

• Siete comodi a lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente ambiguo ed esplorativo con struttura predefinita limitata.

• Si comunica con fiducia ed efficacia sia con esperti tecnici che con gli stakeholder aziendali.

Salute-Porto
Ci impegniamo nell'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF.

Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness.

Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti telefonici via Mobilezone con Sunrise e Swisscom.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Bühler as an Intern in Market Development – Grains & Food and contribute to a strategic assignment focused on shaping future growth opportunities. In this role, you will explore emerging market landscapes, analyze value chains and market dynamics, and identify high-potential business opportunities at the intersection of food systems, innovation, and technology. The role is positioned within the Grains & Food CEO Office at divisional level and reports directly to the Strategy Responsible. It offers exceptional exposure to senior decision-makers, with close collaboration across Business Area leadership and C-level management. This 12 months internship offers a unique opportunity to work independently in an exploratory environment and make a meaningful contribution to the company's future direction.

Aufgaben:
• Explore and structure new growth areas by analyzing value chains, market dynamics, and key industry drivers.

• Identify high-potential applications and business opportunities by combining market insights with technology perspectives.

titleByLocale.it: Gestore del team di assistenza sul campo

descriptionByLocale.it:
In questo ruolo potrai guidare e supportare un team regionale di professionisti del servizio sul campo che installa, mantiene e risolve i problemi delle attrezzature per i clienti. Il tuo obiettivo è aiutare il tuo team a lavorare in modo sicuro, fornire risultati di alta qualità e creare una grande esperienza per i clienti dall'inizio alla fine. Potrai impostare chiare aspettative, coach membri del team e garantire che il lavoro di servizio sia completato in modo efficiente e redditizio. Ti unirai strettamente con i clienti per capire le loro esigenze, risolvere i problemi rapidamente e garantire che ogni progetto soddisfi gli standard di qualità e sicurezza aziendali.

In definitiva, sei responsabile del successo di tutte le attività di servizio sul campo all'interno della tua area di business assegnata, mentre costruisci un team qualificato, motivato e orientato al cliente.

Aufgaben:
• Recrutare, a bordo, sviluppare e gestire le prestazioni degli ingegneri del servizio sul campo (UPS) utilizzando obiettivi chiari, IDP, la matrice delle competenze e SuccessFactors/EPM+.

• Migliorare le competenze dei FSE in materia di competenze meccaniche/elettroniche, esigenze del mercato, qualità della documentazione, comunicazione dei clienti e relazioni professionali; effettuare revisioni post-lavoro.

• Promuovere una cultura di miglioramento della sicurezza, prima continua, allineata ai valori di Bühler, applicando tutte le norme EHS/OSHA/LOTO e garantendo una formazione tempestiva e la segnalazione degli incidenti.

• Mantenere una profonda curiosità tecnica e costruire una forte conoscenza del portafoglio prodotti, delle attrezzature e dei processi di Bühler.

• Pianificare, assegnare e ottimizzare le risorse sul campo per soddisfare le linee temporali dei clienti, commissionando tappe, riparazioni, revisioni e programmi di manutenzione preventiva.

• Esaminare gli ambiti di lavoro, confermare la disponibilità degli strumenti/parti e monitorare i progressi di lavoro durante la gestione delle escalazioni e la risoluzione dei problemi complessi con BU, Ingegneria, Qualità e Supporto remoto.

• Garantire una comunicazione tempestiva e professionale con tutti gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, assumendo la piena titolarità delle richieste dei clienti e delle escalation attraverso la chiusura.

• Coordinare il supporto di servizio per i responsabili del progetto e garantire costi adeguati, citazioni accurate e l'approvazione tempestiva dei fogli orari / spese.

• Gestire l'utilizzo del team, l'aderenza al programma, il controllo dei costi di garanzia e la disciplina di viaggio/spese in linea con gli obiettivi finanziari.

• determinare i tassi di prima fissazione, la qualità del lavoro, il raggiungimento dei KPI e l'individuazione delle opportunità di vendita dei servizi (upgrade, contratti PM, formazione, parti).

• Sfruttare SAP, SuccessFactors, CAQ, CRM e strumenti di reporting per guidare le decisioni, raccomandare miglioramenti e sostenere gli sforzi di miglioramento continuo SQCDP.

Anforderungen:
• 5+ anni di leadership o capacità di guida tecnica è necessario.

• 5+ anni di servizio sul campo industriale (installazione, messa in servizio, risoluzione dei problemi) è preferito.

• Forte conoscenza meccanica e industriale.

• Cliente dimostrato che affronta le capacità di comunicazione e risoluzione dei conflitti.

• Ruolo di leadership/gestione in precedenza.

• Formazione formale di leadership.

• Microsoft Office è necessario.

• L'esperienza SAP è preferibile.

• Esperienza con le apparecchiature di lavorazione degli alimenti (ad esempio, pasta, grano, macinazione, miscelazione, trasporto, termico, o sistemi di selezione) è preferibile.

• Proprietà e giudizio: dà priorità alla sicurezza e alla qualità; prende decisioni di supporto dei dati sotto pressione temporale.

• Coaching Mindset: sviluppa talenti attraverso feedback, sulla formazione professionale e percorsi di apprendimento strutturati.

• Cliente: Centricità: esigenze anti-presenza; comunicazione proattiva; gestione delle aspettative.

You'll partner closely with customers to understand their needs, resolve issues quickly, and ensure every project meets company quality and safety standards. Anforderungen: • 5+ years in people leadership or technical lead capacity is required. • 5+ years in industrial field service (installation, commissioning, troubleshooting) is preferred. • Strong mechanical and industrial knowledge. • Demonstrated customer facing communication skills and conflict resolution. • Prior leadership/management role. • Formal leadership training. • Microsoft Office is required. • SAP experience is preferred. • Experience with food processing equipment (e.g., pasta, grain, milling, mixing, conveying, thermal, or sorting systems) is preferred. • Ownership & Judgment: Prioritizes safety and quality; makes data backed decisions under time pressure. • Coaching Mindset: Develops talent through feedback, on the job training, and structured learning paths. • Customer Centricity: Anticipates needs; communicates proactively; manages expectations. • Collaboration: Works across Product Lines, Engineering, Quality, and Sales to solve problems. • Continuous Improvement: Challenges the status quo; standardizes and shares best practices. Aufgaben:
• You develop and calculate process solutions during sales and quotation phases ranging from individual machines to complete plant concepts, including process flow diagrams, design bases, technical specifications, and the application of quality principles

• You work on different customer projects during the quotation phase and take an active role during the entire project execution phases, ensuring technical excellence, stakeholder alignment, compliance with deadlines, and cost transparency

• You transform customer requirements into technically sound and value-driven process concepts while providing active expert support to Sales, Quotation, and Project Execution teams

Anforderungen:

Lavorerai a stretto contatto con i clienti per capire le loro sfide e guidarli verso attrezzature nuove e usate, aggiornamenti, retrofit e soluzioni di processo complete che supportino i loro obiettivi. With over 160 years of experience, Bühler Leybold Optics is a leading supplier of thin-film vacuum coating technology. Our state-of-the art solutions include semiconductor, precision or ophthalmic optics applications, the metalization of headlights for the automotive industry, architectural and automotive glass, roll-to-roll substrates for capacitors or flexible electronics.

As a Sales Account Manager, you'll play a key role in helping customers find the right precision optics and optoelectronic vacuum coating solutions for their needs. You'll work closely with clients to understand their challenges and guide them toward new and used equipment, upgrades, retrofits, and complete process solutions that support their goals. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to build lasting relationships, shape the customer experience, and help bring innovative technology to market through effective sales strategy and product promotion. • Consideration of commercial consequences for the entire automation scope in the context of the contractual supply of components and services

• 1、根据公司的战略规划，结合市场需求制定产品开发方向，参与SCI新产品可行性进行论证和实施；
• 2、参与识别相关市场潜在新产品需求；
• 3、持续关注科技行业发展趋势，主动识别非相关市场潜在产品需求；
• 4、参与定期收集、整理市场信息（政策、行业、竞争情况、客户需求）；
• 5、参与SCI新产品（设备、核心部件及软件）开发及技术转移；
• 6、参与识别开发过程中的问题，并提出创新流程或方案，并督促流程或方案实施；
• 7、产品关键升级迭代（生命周期）；
• 8、参与支持市场部完成SCI新产品或核心部件市场推广工作；
• 9、完成上级交办的其他工作。 Anforderungen:
• 1、物理类、机械类、电子类、自动化类、光学类专业等相关专业，本科及以上学历 ；
• 2、具有5年以上设备制造业设备开发管理经验，3年以上高真空设备行业经验；
• 3、拥有物理、电气、机械、光学理论或电磁学理论基础；
• 4、熟悉基于热阻蒸发、电子束蒸发、磁控溅射、离子束溅射的PVD技术（至少1项）；
• 5、拥有高真空设备使用或设计经验；
• 6、英文可作为工作语言。 Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der Marktführer im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik Kameras, Head Up Displays von Autos und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.
Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Team der kaufmännischen Auftragsabwicklung in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Unser Wunschkollege (m/w/d) besticht durch Genauigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit und scheut sich nicht davor eigenständig Aufgaben zu übernehmen.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft, u.a. bei der Erstellung von Versandpapieren, der Anlage und Betreuung von Projekten in SAP • Du betreust eigenverantwortlich Aufgabenstellungen im Rahmen der Auftragsabwicklung mit weltweitem Bezug • Du unterstützt beim Zahlungsmanagement für Leistungen externer Vertriebspartner • Du erstellst Auswertungen mit Hilfe von SAP • Du unterstützt in laufenden internen Projekten (z.B. in Bezug auf Prozessverbesserungen) Anforderungen: • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) in einem wirtschaftlichen Studiengang • Du hast einen sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office und idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit SAP • Du hast gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Eine selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise vervollständigt dein Profil Wir bieten: Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Aufgaben: • Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft, u.a. bei der Erstellung von Versandpapieren, der Anlage und Betreuung von Projekten in SAP • Du betreust eigenverantwortlich Aufgabenstellungen im Rahmen der Auftragsabwicklung mit weltweitem Bezug • Du unterstützt beim Zahlungsmanagement für Leistungen externer Vertriebspartner • Du erstellst Auswertungen mit Hilfe von SAP • Du unterstützt in laufenden internen Projekten (z.B. in Bezug auf Prozessverbesserungen) Anforderungen: • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) in einem wirtschaftlichen Studiengang • Du hast einen sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office und idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit SAP • Du hast gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Eine selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise vervollständigt dein Profil Wir bieten: Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about delivering excellent customer service and keeping processes running smoothly? As a Spare Parts Specialist, you will be the key link between our customers and internal teams, including Technical Advisors and Product Master Data Specialists.
In this role, you will coordinate all activities related to spare parts quotation and order processes. Your goal will be to provide customers with accurate, high-quality quotations as quickly as possible, ensuring a seamless and efficient experience from request to order. Aufgaben: • Receive and review customer requests: Accept and evaluate customer inquiries for service-related offerings (e.g. spare parts). Ensure requests are complete and determine appropriate next steps. • Initiate and prepare quotations in ERP (e.g., SAP): Create and process quotations for various customer requirements within the relevant system, ensuring accurate entry of all relevant information. • Communicate effectively with customers: Manage communications with customers regarding their requests and quotations, answering questions, clarifying details, and managing expectations throughout the process. • Complete technical and commercial details: gather, verify, and input all necessary technical specifications and commercial terms to ensure comprehensive and precise quotations. • Ensure efficient information flow: Collect and provide all necessary information and supporting documentation to streamline processing by internal specialists and stakeholders. Anforderungen: • Diploma from upper secondary school in an electrical or mechanical field or equivalent education through other educational paths • Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems • Highly structured, detail-oriented, and conscientious way of working, ability to use time and resources efficiently • Fluent in the local language and English Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler technologies touch billions of people every day by enabling safe food and sustainable mobility. One billion people travel in vehicles with parts produced using Buhler equipment. With this global relevance, we transform today's challenges into sustainable, scalable, and profitable solutions.
The Department Manager Application Technology NAM leads the regional Application Technology function for Die Casting in North America, serving as the primary liaison for advanced process support from initial casting concepts through finished products. This role is part of the Global Die Casting Application Technology organization and partners with Sales, Quotation, Engineering, Customer Service, and Global Product Management to deliver best-in-class technical guidance, process optimization, and training that drives customer success and business growth. Aufgaben: • Lead, develop, and mentor the North American Application Technology team; build capabilities, succession plans, and a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement in close collaboration with the Global Application Technology team • Own the regional application strategy and roadmap aligned to global product strategy; translate market and customer insights into actionable requirements for Product Management • Collaborate with customers on DFM (Design for Manufacturability) to optimize casting designs and reduce total cost of ownership • Proactively drive HPDC applications for future automotive platforms by supporting OEMs in early design and development of future body-in-white, powertrain, battery and chassis components • Co-develop with customers their manufacturing quality framework, including quality standards, process control plans, operational standards for die and equipment maintenance, in-process operations, and post-processing • Support strategic key accounts with process optimization plans and productivity improvement programs • Participate in the proposal engineering process for customer opportunities by defining process/part flow, machine & peripheral equipment requirements, & creating customized customer presentations tailored to the opportunity • Drive revenue development across the local team, in addition to involving the global team, by proactively initiating opportunities and responding to customer requests for part development, process support, trials, and training - converting technical engagements into reoccurring turnover opportunities • Keep in contact with leading universities in the field of HPDC in the NAM region • DC technology scouting: Identify emerging technologies that might expand the application of HPDC and/or improve current HPDC production • Represent Bühler at industry events, technical conferences and seminars, as a subject-matter expert. • Works cross-functionally with Sales and Customer Service to lead operational efforts for Bühler Service Agreements and all other support opportunities to build revenue streams • Financial targets: Setting of and achievement of annual budgets including: • NAM applications and training budget (OR, TO and DB1) • NAM cost budget and cost center coverage Anforderungen: Required Skill and Experience: • Bachelor's degree in engineering or other equivalent training or experience • Deep understanding of high-pressure die casting process and machinery, automation, peripherals (spray systems, ladlers, extractors, thermal control, etc) • Proven experience improving casting quality, yield, cycle time, and OEE through process optimization and data-driven problem solving. • Demonstrated leadership experience managing technical teams and cross-functional initiatives. • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation) with the ability to influence at all organizational levels and within customer hierarchies. • Strong customer relationship management and consultative skills. • Highly developed computer skills in Microsoft 365 Preferred Skill and Experience • Experience with Bühler die casting solutions or comparable OEM / Tier 1 experience • Knowledge of die design fundamentals, thermal management, lubricants, and alloy behavior (e.g., Al, Mg, Zn). • Experience with simulation, process monitoring, and analytics tools (e.g., Flow3D, Magmasoft,). • Experience in a global matrix organization a plus. • Leadership skills in local and international environments • Ability to work accurately and reliably under pressure • Coaching of employees in professional and personal development • Strong leadership personality and sense for people development • Target and results oriented • Openness, teamwork, descriptionByLocale.it:
The Service Agreements Regional Partner is responsible for driving the growth and execution of service agreements across Southeast Asia. This role partners closely with the Sales organization to expand Bühler's service portfolio by identifying opportunities, developing tailored contractual solutions, and securing long-term service agreements. The position plays a critical role in defining commercial structures, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering customer success through strong contractual partnerships. Aufgaben:
• Take full ownership of the assigned portfolio of service agreements (e.g., Remote Services, Inspection, and Maintenance), ensuring delivery excellence and high customer satisfaction.
• Develop and lead a regional support structure, including quotation management, contract delivery, and back-office operations.
• Act as the primary point of contact for all contractual service matters, ensuring timely and effective execution aligned with customer expectations.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Project Execution, Field Service, Spare Parts, and Automation teams to deliver integrated service solutions.
• Drive operational excellence and standardization of service agreement management across the SEA region.
• Oversee contract renewal processes, pricing strategies, and cost control measures to maintain profitability.
• Develop and present integrated service proposals that balance customer needs with business objectives.
• Support the identification, development, quotation, and negotiation of complex service agreements.
• Establish and maintain region-specific cost calculation models in alignment with global guidelines.
• Work with technical, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and competitive proposals.
• Maintain comprehensive documentation of quotations, contracts, and handover processes.
• Communicate proactively with stakeholders on proposal status, pricing updates, and contract execution progress.
• Collaborate with global teams to share insights and continuously improve service offerings and customer experience.
• Support the implementation of service frameworks, processes, tools, and best practices within the region Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in value-based selling or front-end commercial roles.
• Strong understanding of maintenance strategies and planning methodologies.
• Solid commercial acumen, including pricing, cost management, and risk assessment.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
• Fluency in English (written and spoken).
• Self-motivated with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and results-driven approach.
• Ability to operate effectively within a matrix organization across multiple countries and business units.
• Proven ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Ensure support of M2M development projects in a technical role based on the existing worldwide
supply chain platform and corporate strategy, supporting until the first serial machines. Strategy
includes logistical concepts as well as risk mitigation approaches for all key components.
Focus on the understanding of technical problems and scouting of solutions and propose them
throughout the different development stages, transferring the know-how from our supply chain
partners as well as screening of new market innovations to be applied on our current or future
products and services.
Proposed solutions should be designed to function, consider manufacturing technologies, and cost
optimised solutions. Furthermore, the role involves design inputs combined with manufacturing
optimisation for single components as well as assemblies. Aufgaben: • Ensure the entire supply chain process as defined in the M2M process during the development and prototyping phase of major equipment and systems, starting from business plan, with the supply chain strategy (supported by senior M2M supply chain engineer) • Interdisciplinary cooperation in cross-divisional contexts, with development and production as well as the associated specialist departments in the project environment, active exchange in the team • Project support for machine developments from supply chain perspective along the phases (BP, CN, DD, IN) including aspect of: Logistic, own and third manufacturing and manufacturing technologies • Support of larger life cycle projects or product transfers, after the market introduction phase • Perform market studies and benchmarks to drive make-or-buy decisions according to total cost principals, coordinated with all relevant stake holders, considering the existing supplier base, the category strategy, the own production strategy, and new potential suppliers • Supplier validation and negotiation of contracts (engineering-, confidentiality-, development-, framework- and quality agreement-contracts) • Consulting in in design aspect such as design to cost, design to manufacturing, design to logistic • Audits of suppliers and sub sequent development of suppliers to reach the defined quality level, responsible for the fulfilment of First Article Inspection • Ensure compliance according to required worldwide norms such as food contact material, electrical norms etc. • Driver for standardization and reduction of complexity. • Exchange with other procurement departments and lead buyers to exchange knowhow and adopt existing solutions • Cost tracking along the phases of the M2M development process. • Ensure risk mitigation with a proper 2nd source strategy • Coordination of development partnerships with suppliers and internal departments. • Maintenance of master data (audit reports, certificates, price lists) in the corresponding systems prior product introduction Anforderungen: • Basic technical education or career • Degree in mechanical and or electrical/software engineering from a university or university of applied sciences • Professional experience in industrial supply chains • Ability to solve problems in a structured way • Technical affinity • Understanding of holistic correlations within the company and business management interrelationship • Negotiation's skills and knowledge of contracts and laws • Experience in execution of development projects • English language skills at C1 and possibly other languages • Proven IT skills (Office, Web applications, internet, SAP, CAD, PDM) • Analytical skills and negotiation skills • Problem structuring and problem-solving skills • Cross-business unit thinking and acting • Presentation skills with positive charisma • Oriented towards the corporate supply chain strategy to secure competitive advantages for the company and the customer • Capability for cost tracking along the M2M process • Selves driven and used to take decisions / ability to work in a team and deal with conflict • Ability as consultant for the project team along the project stages • Customer-oriented mind set, strong and focused implementation skills • Above-average personal commitment • Integrity / assertiveness and creativity • Proven ability to convince and motivate • Intercultural management • Good written and oral expression in English language, German is a plus Two billion people eat food every day that was descriptionByLocale.it:
The Quotation Specialist supports Customer Service, Outside Sales, and Bühler Group teams by preparing accurate quotations, processing orders, coordinating internal documentation, and supporting customer growth. This role helps develop existing and new customer opportunities, contributes to monthly sales targets at appropriate gross margins, and ensures timely, professional communication throughout the quotation and order process.
The position serves as an internal coordinator from initial customer request through order receipt and delivery, working closely with customers, vendors, sales, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, finance, accounting, purchasing, and shipping. Aufgaben: • Respond to customer inquiries and direct requests to the appropriate contact when needed. • Understand the customers' needs; able to accurately identify spare parts, calculate pricing, and provide detailed shipping information & documentation. • Prepare cost sheets, quotations, and customer proposals. • Coordinate with vendors, procurement, engineering, and manufacturing to obtain current pricing, lead times, and product information. • Price manufactured items while supporting standard margin objectives. • Work with outside sales engineers to develop complete and accurate proposals. • Follow up with customers on proposal status and provide updates on order status. • Review new projects with engineering as needed. • Review historical documentation and databases to support quotation and order accuracy. • Investigate quality issues & customer complaints; understand the root cause and implement quality gates to prevent recurrence. • Participate in departmental training and continuous improvement efforts • Other tasks as deemed necessary by management. Anforderungen: Job Specifications • Bachelor's degree is a plus but not required. • 1–3 years of inside sales, customer service, or related experience preferred. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite with exceptional verbal, written, and communication skills. • Experience with business systems such as SAP and CRM • Mechanical mindset with aptitude for navigating the Windchill environment to access, interpret, and process engineering drawings, CAD models, and BOMs Knowledge, Skills and Abilities • Strong organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills. • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with accuracy and attention to detail. • Professional communication skills, both verbal and written. • Ability to build strong working relationships with customers, vendors, colleagues, and internal departments. • Customer-focused mindset with strong service, quality, value, and reliability orientation. • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while following company guidelines. • Sound judgment, timely decision-making, and willingness to take responsibility. • Ability to identify risks, propose solutions, and support continuous improvement. • Flexibility, adaptability, and openness to change. • Strong teamwork, conflict-resolution, and cross-functional coordination skills. • Professional appearance, self-confidence, persistence, and self-motivation. • Industry awareness, including competitors, market trends, and business opportunities. • Keen investigator and researcher; proficient at finding missing details • Buhler TOP value proponent; contributes to improving the company culture Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und Wachstum. Als Teil der globalen Bühler Group mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden sind wir führender Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren entwickeln wir Lösungen für Architekturglas, Brillengläser sowie optische Komponenten in Smartphones, Fahrzeugen und der Medizintechnik.

Für unseren Standort Leipzig suchen wir einen motivierten Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im Bereich Supply Chain. Sie planen und steuern unsere Supply Chain und tragen so zu einem reibungslosen Projektablauf bei. Wenn Sie Einsatzbereitschaft, Freundlichkeit und Freude an neuen Herausforderungen mitbringen, freuen wir uns auf Sie.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
As a temporary maternity leave/Shipping Coordinator, you will become part of our team in Skovlunde, which currently consists of 3 employees. You will be responsible for coordinating all types of transport.
This position is a full-time role from November 1, 2026, until February 28, 2027. Aufgaben: • Booking and coordination of national and international courier, air, sea, and road transport • Daily contact with freight forwarders and colleagues at Bühler • Handling of spare parts orders • Preparation and checking of export documents, invoicing, and freight rates • Daily updating and maintenance of data in SAP (knowledge of SAP is not required) • Training in our procedures and work processes Anforderungen: You are a newly qualified Shipping Coordinator/Freight Forwarder or have experience from a similar position. In addition, we imagine that you: • Are structured, detail-oriented, and independent • Are helpful and contribute with a positive attitude • Can maintain an overview in a busy working day • Having good Danish and English skills, both spoken and written Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per il nostro laboratorio analitico stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata e curiosa per uno stage nel campo dell'analisi fisica. In questo ruolo versatile, ci supporterete nella caratterizzazione dei prodotti alimentari e dei materiali tecnici e otterrete interessanti approfondimenti sui metodi di analisi moderni come le dimensioni delle particelle, la viscosità, il colore, la texture e le analisi termiche. Essi lavorano precisamente sulla preparazione del campione, la valutazione e l'interpretazione dei risultati di misura e contribuiscono a rispondere alle domande tecnologiche. Sarete in scambio con il nostro team di laboratorio, partner interni e clienti e può contribuire le vostre abilità analitiche per progetti di sviluppo e svilupparli ulteriormente. Compiti:
• Essi forniscono servizi analitici per la caratterizzazione dei materiali alimentari e tecnici
• Parlano di domande e analisi con clienti, clienti e partner commerciali
• Eseguono analisi di routine come dimensioni delle particelle, viscosità, colore, texture e analisi termiche
• Preparano campioni, valutano i risultati, interpretano i risultati e producono report scritti
• Essi sviluppano inoltre metodi fisici e supportano in modo indipendente le sottozone nei progetti di sviluppo Requisiti
• Laurea in ingegneria o scienze naturali, idealmente in ingegneria meccanica di processo, scienze alimentari o chimica fisica
• Metodo di analisi preciso e persistente
• Divertimento di lavorare insieme in una squadra
• Il pensiero analitico e l'interesse per le questioni tecniche e scientifiche
• Buone capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese, sia orale che scritta Offriamo: Ristorante personale VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito. Porta salute Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Abbonamenti mobili Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti mobili tramite Mobilezone a Sunrise e Swisscom. Attività sportive Promuoviamo lo sport attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e il fitness attivo. Attraente diritto di vacanza Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. descriptionByLocale.en:
For our analytical laboratory we are looking for a committed and curious personality for an internship in the field of physical analytics. In this versatile role, you will support us in the characterization of foodstuffs and technical materials and gain exciting insights into modern analysis methods such as particle size, viscosity, color, texture and thermal analyses. They work precisely on sample preparation, evaluation and interpretation of measurement results and contribute to answering technological questions. You will be in exchange with our laboratory team, internal partners and customers and can contribute your analytical skills to development projects and further develop them. Tasks:
• They provide analytical services for the characterization of food and technical materials
• They discuss questions and analyses with clients, customers and business partners
• They perform routine analyses such as particle size, viscosity, colour, texture and thermal analyses
• They prepare samples, evaluate results, interpret results and produce written reports
• They further develop physical methods and independently support sub-areas in development projects Requirements
• Graduate degree in engineering or natural sciences, ideally in mechanical process engineering, food sciences or physical chemistry
• Precise and persistent method of analysis
• Enjoyment of working together in a team
• Analytical thinking and interest in technical and scientific questions
• Good communication skills in German and English, both oral and written We offer: Staff restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking. Health port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Mobile subscriptions We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and Swisscom. Sports activities We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness. Attractive holiday entitlement Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life. Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle unterstützen Sie uns bei der Charakterisierung von Nahrungsmitteln und technischen Materialien und erhalten spannende Einblicke in moderne Analyseverfahren wie Partikelgrössen-, Viskositäts-, Farb-, Textur- und Thermoanalysen. • Sie besprechen Fragestellungen und Analysen mit Auftraggebenden, Kundschaft und Geschäftspartnern
• Sie führen Routineanalysen wie Partikelgrössen-, Viskositäts-, Farb-, Textur- und Thermoanalysen durch
• Sie bereiten Proben vor, werten Ergebnisse aus, interpretieren Resultate und erstellen schriftliche Berichte
• Sie entwickeln physikalische Methoden weiter und unterstützen selbständig Teilbereiche in Entwicklungsprojekten Anforderungen:

Dans ce rôle polyvalent, vous nous accompagnerez dans la caractérisation des aliments et des matériaux techniques et gagnerez des connaissances passionnantes sur les méthodes d'analyse modernes telles que la taille des particules, la viscosité, la couleur, la texture et les analyses thermiques. Ils travaillent précisément sur la préparation d'échantillons, l'évaluation et l'interprétation des résultats des mesures et contribuent à répondre aux questions technologiques. Vous serez en échange avec notre équipe de laboratoire, nos partenaires internes et nos clients et pourrez apporter vos compétences analytiques aux projets de développement et les développer davantage. Tâches :

• Ils discutent des questions et des analyses avec les clients, les clients et les partenaires commerciaux
• Ils effectuent des analyses de routine telles que la taille des particules, la viscosité, la couleur, la texture et les analyses thermiques
• Ils préparent des échantillons, évaluent les résultats, interprètent les résultats et produisent des rapports écrits
• Ils développent davantage les méthodes physiques et soutiennent indépendamment les sous-domaines dans les projets de développement. Exigences
• Diplômé en génie ou en sciences naturelles, idéalement en génie des procédés mécaniques, en sciences alimentaires ou en chimie physique
• Méthode d'analyse précise et persistante
• Profitez de travailler ensemble dans une équipe
• Pensée analytique et intérêt pour les questions techniques et scientifiques

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de compte de vente - Wheat & Rye

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join our dynamic team as a Sales Account Manager and become a key player in shaping the future of the grain industry! In this role, you'll be driving the promotion and sales of Bühler's innovative Wheat and Rye equipment across the US territory. Your mission will be to craft and execute sales strategies, engage with both existing and potential clients, and uncover their unique needs to deliver tailored solutions. You'll spearhead the development of both existing and new business opportunities while gathering invaluable market insights. If you're passionate about sales and ready to take on exciting challenges, we want you to be part of our journey towards transforming the industry! Aufgaben:
• Direct sales, promoting and selling the Buhler equipment and related equipment in a defined geography
• Develop and implement a sales plan for market and account coverage
• Prospecting, identifying new customers and working with existing owners to ensure that Buhler machinery is top of mind for all new projects
• Manages and maintains assigned accounts and key accounts
• Fosters customer relationships
• Develops and establishes new accounts
• Customer contact, collecting information, negotiating contracts
• Communicates and participates in solving problems related to customer orders or concerns
• Collects market data (customer and competition) that show the need of the businesses and industries within the territory
• Generating enquiries, filling out internal RFQ's and presenting quotes and proposals to the customer
• Close sales to meet or exceed a sales quota
• Attend trade shows as required, attend customer FATs, and travel to Europe as required
• Attend trainings in Europe as needed
• File customer contact reports, call reports and other pertinent information in a CRM
• Other duties as assigned Anforderungen:
• Bachelors Degree in Business, Engineering or equivalent
• Background in Food/Agriculture industry strongly preferred
• Strong mechanical/technical acumen desired
• 5+ years selling capital goods to the food industry
• Attention to detail
• Excellent organization, interpersonal communication skills and relationship building skills to effectively work with a variety of people and personalities; able to communicate clearly and effectively in person and in writing internally and externally
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
• Strong market and commercial awareness
• Ability to build relationships internally and externally while working across time zones and cultures
• A sales leader who can inspire others
• Experience in key account management and directing key account sales teams
• Interpersonal - considers the needs and feelings of others and appropriately responds to different situations
• Maintains discipline, recommending and administering corrective action according to company policy and procedures
• Advanced MS Office skills: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook
• Oral and Written Communication - presents information, analysis, and ideas in writing in a clear and concise manner; speaks clearly so that others can hear and understand what is being said
• Speaks and understands English, German and/or Spanish a plus
• Domestic and international travel 65% of time which may include long hours and non-traditional work schedules Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Define system requirements and develop complete system solution on time, within budget, and in line with Bühler's quality, design, and EHS standards. The aim is to achieve a high level of customer satisfaction and risk mitigation. A System Engineer further details the functional requirements set by the process engineer and serves as the contact for other Bühler engineering disciplines and elaborate base for automation. The systems engineer “build the bridge” between the functional (Process, HW engineering) and the physical design (3D design and Installation Engineering). Aufgaben:
• Review the work package to ensure it meets process requirements and scope, identify deviations and risks, and propose mitigation actions.
• Help prepare project deliverables and estimate the needed engineering hours for the needed activities.
• Ensure that all interfaces with other engineering disciplines are coordinated in line with the assigned work package and establish effective interdisciplinary communication.
• Set up Site Structure with the plant, Line, Area and Function Groups. Define the necessary request objects on unit and sub-unit level.
• Defining Real Devices for all the objects within the Site structure incl. Location Structure, Customer Description and link to PCE Requests.
• Responsible for the definition and quality of all necessary attributes and data for the hand over to the automation department of small to medium plants. (E.g. Emergency System specification, safety relevant indication, pre-wiring information, interlocks)
• Ensure compliance with process requirements and maintain sizing calculations and functional requirements for specifying third-party equipment and piping.
• Visualize the data with different level of degree on PFD and PIDs according Bühler standards.
• Ensure that the arrangement and the piping routing correspond to the process requirements.
• Resolve questions or problems that occur during the design and manufacturing as well as during installation and commissioning and prepare as-built documentation.
• Record any project deviations, technical issues and product improvements in the Bühler CAQ system or via ticket to service desk.
• Capture return of experience and best practice, apply lessons learned to all templates Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, or equivalent
• Proven ability to work in a matrix organization
• Good interpersonal and teamwork skills
• Good problem solving skills
• Basic knowledge in CAD tool
• Proficiency in English language Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. descriptionByLocale.it:
Starte deine Ausbildung bei Bühler in Beilngries ab Herbst 2026 und freu dich auf:

• Startprämie 500, - Euro + zusätzliche Prämien für deine guten Leistungen
• Ausbildungsvergütung bis zu 1.410, - Euro pro Monat
• Azubi-Auto für Fahrten zur Berufsschule
• 1 Woche bezahlter Lernurlaub
• Spannende Azubi-Projekte und Ausflüge
• Mitarbeitervergünstigungen für viele Shops
• International offene Türen nach deinem Abschluss dank unserer Standorte auf der ganzen Welt

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen. Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit. • Als Konstruktionsmechaniker (m/w/d) bist du für die Erstellung der Bauteile unserer Maschinen und Anlagen zuständig. • Nach einigen Wochen in der Lehrwerkstatt wirst du alle Bereiche unserer Fertigung kennenlernen und schnell im Auftragsgeschäft aktiv mitarbeiten. • Unsere Ausbildung ist sehr vielfältig und bietet dir einen perfekten Einstieg in das Berufsleben. • Die Ausbildung dauert i.d.R. 3,5 Jahre, die Berufsschule ist in Eichstätt. Anforderungen: • Du interessierst dich für Technik, hast ein gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen und handwerkliches Geschick. • Außerdem bist du engagiert und zuverlässig, Teamarbeit macht dir Spaß. • Mit dem Mittelschulabschluss und guten Noten in Mathematik, sowie den naturwissenschaftlichen Fächern, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Und nach der Ausbildung? • Dieser Beruf bietet ein sehr breites Feld an Chancen nach der Ausbildung. • Du kannst als Konstruktionsmechaniker (m/w/d) in unserer Fertigung arbeiten oder als Außenmonteur „die große Freiheit“ kennenlernen. • Wenn du dich noch weiterbilden möchtest (z.B. Industriemeister, Techniker, Maschinenbaustudium oder Ähnliches), bietet dir Bühler dabei Unterstützung an. Wir bieten: • Familiäre Unternehmenskultur • Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Grossartiger Kaffee und frisches Obst Geniessen Sie unsere Annehmlichkeiten, wie kostenlosen Premium-Kaffee und frisches Obst - für Ihren perfekten Start in den Tag! Angebote für Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden Wir bieten eine Reihe von Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangeboten, die Sie dabei unterstützen, sich körperlich und geistig wohl zu fühlen. descriptionByLocale.it:
Prendere un ruolo chiave nella formazione globale di Bühler Finance & Controling. Come proprietario di prodotti esperto, si guida processo e progettazione di soluzioni su SAP S/4HANA, che agisce come il integratore tra Finance & Controling e i nostri team aguzza. Migliorate continuamente le funzionalità e spingete il nostro panorama Finance & Controling verso l'eccellenza. Aufgaben:
• Guidate come parte del team globale di agile, lo sviluppo di soluzioni end-to-end per la contabilità, il controllo, il Tesoro, la fiscalità e la gestione dei viaggi
• assicurate la consegna continua del valore in una configurazione SAFe, con OKR chiari e risultati misurabili
• possiedi, affina e prioritize il Backlog del Team, eseguite la pianificazione e la revisione di Sprint, preparate e contribuite a PI Plannings e Demo di sistema
• collaborate con gli stakeholder per perfezionare i requisiti e progettare soluzioni di valore aggiunto per Bühler garantendo al contempo linee guida IT soprattutto in materia di conformità, sicurezza, continuità
• Gestite la Liscio passaggio e interfaccia in corso tra sviluppo e operazioni soluzioni Anforderungen:
• Hai una laurea in Informatica, Business Informatica, Business Administration, o un campo correlato
• Hai diversi anni di esperienza come Titolare del Prodotto, preferibile in ambiente SAFE o un'esperienza di leadership laterale comparabile
• Hai un background in Finanza con esperienza in SAP S/4 Hana (FI/CO) e alta affinità per la progettazione di processi e la creazione di esperienza utente
• Hai familiarità con eventi chiave able (ad esempio, Sprint Planning, PI Planning, System Demos) e idealmente tenere certificazioni come SAFE POPM, PSPO o CSPO
• Lei comunica chiaramente in inglese e tedesco e sa come mobilitare e allineare gli stakeholder senza autorità formale Wirbiet: VIVA Restaurant Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero a partire da 9, 00 CHF. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + carta di viaggio a metà prezzo per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente biglietto di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito.Salute-Port Ci impegniamo a prevenire la salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, trucchi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.Abbonamenti per cellulari Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti per cellulari via Mobilezone con Sunrise e Swisscom. Supporto familiare I genitori / guardiani possono acquistare sconti dal Kita Chinderhus Rägeboge Uzwil. Piani pensionistici finanziati dai datori di lavoro Il Fondo Pensione Bühler offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensionistico indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile nel pensionamento: www.pk-buhler.ch Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler mira a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, mentre sviluppa soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Take a key role in shaping Bühler's global Finance & Controlling. As an experienced Product Owner, you drive process and solution design on SAP S/4HANA, acting as integrator between Finance & Controlling and our agile teams. You continuously improve functionalities and push our Finance & Controlling landscape toward excellence. Aufgaben:
• You drive as part of the global agile team, the development of end-to-end solutions for Accounting, Controlling, Treasury, Tax, and Travel Management
• You ensure continuous value delivery in a SAFe setup, with clear OKRs and measurable outcomes
• You own, refine and prioritize the Team Backlog, run Sprint Planning and Reviews, prepare and contribute to PI Plannings and System Demos
• You collaborate with stakeholders to refine requirements and design value-adding solutions for Bühler while ensuring IT guidelines especially around compliance, security, continuity
• You manage the smooth handover and ongoing interface between solution development and operations Anforderungen:
• You hold a degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Business Administration, or a related field
• You bring several years of experience as a Product Owner, preferable in SAFe environment or comparable lateral leadership experience
• You have a background in Finance with experience in SAP S/4 Hana (FI/CO) and high affinity for designing processes and creating user experience
• You are familiar with key agile events (e.g., Sprint Planning, PI Planning, System Demos) and ideally hold certifications such as SAFe POPM, PSPO, or CSPO
• You communicate clearly in English and German and know how to mobilize and align stakeholders without formal authority Wir bieten: VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. • Sie sind Teil des globalen agilen Teams, der Entwicklung von End-to-End-Lösungen für Buchhaltung, Controlling, Treasury, Tax und Travel Management

• Sie besitzen, verfeinern und priorisieren das Team Backlog, führen Sprint Planung und Reviews, bereiten und tragen zu PI Planungen und System-Demos bei
• Sie arbeiten mit Stakeholdern zusammen, um Anforderungen zu verfeinern und wertsteigernde Lösungen für Bühler zu entwerfen, während Sie IT-Richtlinien insbesondere rund um Compliance, Sicherheit, Kontinuität sicherstellen
• Sie verwalten die reibungslose Übergabe und laufende Schnittstelle zwischen Lösungsentwicklung und Betrieb ellen:
• Sie haben einen Abschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einem verwandten Bereich
• Sie bringen mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Produkteigner, besser in SAFe-Umgebung oder vergleichbarer seitlicher Führungserfahrung
• Sie haben einen Hintergrund in der Finanzwirtschaft mit Erfahrung in SAP S/4 Hana (FI/CO) und hoher Affinität zur Gestaltung von Prozessen und zur Erstellung von Benutzererfahrung
• Sie kennen wichtige agile Ereignisse (z.B. Sprint Planning, PI Planning, System Demos) und sind bestens in der Lage, Zertifizierungen wie SAFe POPM, PSPO oder CSPO

Unisciti al nostro team globale di Servizi Finanziari e Affari Commerciali e aiuta a modellare i processi doganali e commerciali in un'organizzazione internazionale a matrice. Come Global Customs Advisor presso la nostra sede a Uzwil, sosterrai sia le nostre business unit locali che le nostre filiali globali come partner chiave per lo sdoganamento, la conformità e l'ottimizzazione dei processi. Con la tua esperienza, guiderai la progettazione dei processi di importazione ed esportazione, sosterrà la determinazione dell'origine delle merci e consiglierà su un'ampia gamma di questioni commerciali estere. Questa è un'occasione emozionante per assumere un ruolo con portata internazionale e impatto reale sulle imprese. Aufgaben:
• Lei è il consulente doganale globale e fornisce una guida specializzata sui processi di importazione/esportazione, sull'origine delle merci e su altre questioni relative al commercio estero
• Lei consiglia e sostiene attivamente le nostre unità commerciali in Uzwil e filiali globali sullo sdoganamento, l'ottimizzazione e le domande relative all'origine
• Lei rappresenta argomenti commerciali esteri in progetti interni del Gruppo, processo di guida, dati e miglioramenti IT e sostiene SAP GTS rollouts attraverso sedi del Gruppo

• Laurea in amministrazione aziendale o qualifica analoga, idealmente con una specializzazione nel commercio estero
• Esperti esperti in diritto doganale svizzero ed europeo, combinati con una solida esperienza pratica nel settore doganale e del commercio estero, preferibilmente all'interno di un ambiente industriale internazionale

Join our global Financial Services and Trade Affairs team and help shape customs and foreign trade processes in an international matrix organization. As a Global Customs Advisor at our headquarters in Uzwil, you will support both our local business units and our global subsidiaries as a key partner in customs clearance, compliance, and process optimization. With your expertise, you will drive the design of import and export processes, support the determination of origin of goods, and advise on a wide range of foreign trade matters. descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der Marktführer im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik Kameras, Head Up Displays von Autos und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Team in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Unser Wunschkollege (m/w/d) besticht durch Engagement und Zuverlässigkeit und scheut sich nicht davor eigenständig Aufgaben zu übernehmen.
